name: Incremental Local Ambient Occlusion
definition: An incremental method to compute volumetric LAO by updating one ray direction per frame and storing the accumulated result in an ambient light texture using OpenGL blend operations, allowing user interaction during computation.
summary: Incremental Local Ambient Occlusion is a volume rendering shading model that computes local lighting from spherical neighborhoods using semitransparency and incremental updates for interactive frame rates.
